_what: Accessibility semantics for the A2UI Basic Catalog. The catalog declares none — the protocol says nothing about accessibility anywhere — so this is OUR reading of it: a stated assumption, not an inference. Property names were read from the published catalog, not guessed.
_gaps: Two components cannot carry a text alternative at all, whatever a renderer does: Video (url + posterUrl only, so WCAG 1.1.1 cannot be met) and Modal (trigger + content only, so the dialog has no accessible name for 4.1.2). Both are reported by check() as catalog gaps rather than blamed on the answer. A third kind: Button REQUIRES an action and the catalog never enumerates which actions exist, so no renderer can tell an allowed one from an invented one.
